title: New train: LE 232 from Przemyśl Gł. to Frankfurt (Main) Flughafen
summary: A new train service, LE 232, has been added, operating daily from Przemyśl Gł. to Frankfurt (Main) Flughafen Fernbahnhof. The route includes stops at Rzeszów Gł., Kraków Gł., Bohumín, Ostrava hl.n., Olomouc hl.n., Pardubice hl.n., Praha hl.n., Ústí nad Labem hl.n., Děčín hl.n., Erfurt Hbf, Fulda, and Hanau Hbf.
